sprints.name: CE Sprint 1
sprints.goal: Students can order, get a token and track it; kitchen works the live queue; code is built and tested by Jenkins on every push.

sprints.name: CE Sprint 2
sprints.goal: Admin tools and order history; every merge to main is deployed automatically and the stack is monitored.

issues.story: As a student, I want to create an account and log in, so that my orders are linked to me.
criteria: Student can register with name, email and password (min 6 characters)
Duplicate email is rejected
Login returns a session that lasts 8 hours
Staff and admin log in with seeded accounts and land on their own home page

issues.story: As a student, I want to browse the menu by category and search it, so that I can quickly find what to eat.
criteria: Menu shows name, price, category and veg/non-veg marker
Category chips and a search box filter the list
Sold-out items are hidden
Menu is served from the Redis cache

issues.summary: Add to cart, place order and get a token
issues.story: As a student, I want to place my order from class and get a token number, so that I don't have to stand in the queue.
criteria: Cart supports + / - with a limit of 10 per item
Total is calculated by the server, not the browser
Token numbers restart at 1 every day (IST)
Ordering a sold-out item is rejected

issues.story: As kitchen staff, I want a live queue of orders, so that I can cook them in order and mark them ready.
criteria: Queue has New, Preparing and Ready columns and refreshes every 3 seconds
Orders move PLACED -> PREPARING -> READY -> COLLECTED only
Staff can cancel an order that is not ready yet
Staff can mark a dish sold out

issues.story: As a student, I want to see my order status change live, so that I walk to the canteen only when food is ready.
criteria: Tracking page shows the token and a 4-step tracker
Status refreshes every 3 seconds without reload
Student can cancel only while the order is PLACED
A student cannot see another student's order

issues.story: Create the repository and agree the workflow: one branch per issue named feature/CE-<n>-<slug>, commit messages start with the issue key, merge to main only through a reviewed pull request.
Containerise the backend (Node) and frontend (multi-stage build served by Nginx) and run them with MySQL and Redis from a single docker-compose.yml with healthchecks and a named volume for data.

issues.summary: Jenkins CI pipeline: install, lint, test, build
issues.story: Multibranch Jenkins job reading the Jenkinsfile from the repo. Every branch runs install, lint, backend and frontend tests (JUnit reports) and builds Docker images. Branches are picked up automatically by a periodic scan.
As a student, I want to see my past orders, so that I can reorder favourites and check what I paid.
criteria: Shows only the logged-in student's orders, newest first
Each row shows token, items, time, status and total
Clicking a row opens live tracking

issues.story: As the canteen admin, I want to add, edit and remove dishes, so that the menu always matches the kitchen.
criteria: Admin can add a dish with name, category, price and veg flag
Price must be between 1 and 10000
Changes appear for students immediately (cache cleared)
Only admin can delete; staff can only mark sold out

issues.story: As the canteen admin, I want a sales dashboard, so that I know the rush hours and best sellers.
criteria: Shows today's revenue, orders, active orders and average prep time
Revenue for the last 7 days and orders by hour today
Top 5 items by quantity
Every chart has a table view

issues.summary: Jenkins CD: automatic deployment of main
issues.story: Extend the pipeline so that main is deployed with docker compose after the tests pass, followed by a smoke test that checks the new version is live. A failed smoke test rolls back to the last good version.
Expose /metrics from the API (requests, latency, orders, revenue, kitchen queue), scrape it with Prometheus, add alert rules and provision a Grafana dashboard.

issues.summary: Nagios checks for the stack and host
issues.story: Run Nagios in the stack with checks for the web app, API health, MySQL, Redis and the host machine through NRPE (from Experiment 7).
